comments.author: swiftduck
comments.body_html:
Nice mod.

I noticed some quirks. I dont mind them.

This slows down some things but most things work in normal speed during the slowdown. Actors (including you) move in slow motion at the appropriate percentage of dilation specified in the BepInEx menu. SOME of your weapon animations slow down, most impactfully your manual cycling animations like bolt and lever actions. Turn speed is affected for you and bots. You move your gun slower. (they seem to as well but it matters less for them.)

Rate of fire is not affected. You can set the dilation to .1 and mag dump a drum mag in less than a second (sort of) Item use is not affected. You can slow time and use up an entire grizzly before the scav gets around the corner. Projectile speeds are not affected. No neo shenanigans. Grenade timer is not affected. Throw a fused ‘nade with the dilation turned too far down and it will probably detonate in mid air right next to your face. ask me how i know this :D AI are only affected in that their movements are slowed. If they can move the gun to aim at you, they will mag dump you without regard to the time slow. They will ramp up their aim accuracy without regard to the slow time, too. It’s actually safer NOT to use the bullet time when caught out because you move slower but the bots don’t aim slower and the bullets dont move slower and the guns don’t fire slower. I did see a bot blow himself up with a grenade once. I did an entire raid in .1 dilation while having my morning coffee. weirdly chill experience. I died to a bot mag dump through a window from god knows how far away lol.

This is very useful in short bursts for lining up long shots or head shots. You are in great danger if you stand in front of an aggressive bot and go slow-mo, though. It’s way less OP than i thought it would be and i now use it set at .4 just to give me a little edge in decisive shots.

Great fun with this mod. Had a good time figuring out all the quirks of it.
